messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #492 (streamlined snippets + quant profile) is ready for docs review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
samir: assigning myself for SDK snippet update. will push a patch in ~2h. @elaine can you do the quant profile sanity checks?
elaine: yep, I'll run the profile tests on desktop and try 8-bit vs 4-bit tradeoffs. will post results.
maya: main asks: 1) add an end-to-end JS + Python minimal example for batching; 2) show KV-prefetch suggestion and link to Optimize heuristics; 3) include a simple quant profile YAML example and a note about sequence length impacts.
samir: for the JS snippet i'm thinking:

```js
const res = await redwood.generate({
  model: 'redwood/rlhf-2',
  input: arrOfPrompts,
  batch_size: 8,
  cache_policy: 'prefix',
});
``` 

is that too prescriptive?
elaine: fine, but call out that batch_size=8 is a suggestion; add: "measure p95 latency after 10k requests". Also we should include the quant YAML:

```yaml
quant_profile: 'balanced'
bits: 4
fallback_to_fp16: true
recommended_seq_len: 512
```

docs-bot: NOTE: crosslink to /optimize/heuristics and /console/kv-prefetch (broken link check flagged both)
ryan: i'll do the linkfix PR review. Also — can we add a short migration note for Dedicated customers about pinned model variants and quant profile compatibility?
maya: yes, add a Migration: Dedicated section with a 1-paragraph note and a small checklist. i'll draft.
samir: pushed snippet branch to pr/492-snippet. pinging for review.
elaine: test results: 4-bit improved throughput x2 on local but quality drop on some prompts; i'm adding an eval snippet and a short 'when to choose 4-bit' note.
maya: great. next steps: @ryan review links, @samir update JS + Python snippets, @elaine add quant eval notes, i'll fold everything and merge on Thursday.
samir: one more ask — can devx add a small note about how the SDK handles streaming + batching? @devx
devx: noted. i'll add a one-liner and a link to the SDK streaming docs.
maya: thanks all :shipit:
